sections.heading: C — Basic driving
sections.markdown:
## C — Basic driving

FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A30
Follow the vehicle owner's manual for its starting procedure. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A30
Set the parking brake before starting the vehicle. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A30
Before starting an automatic-transmission vehicle, put the right foot on the brake pedal. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A30
Before starting an automatic-transmission vehicle, check that the selector is in park. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A30
Before starting a manual-transmission vehicle, press the clutch fully down with the left foot. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A30
Before starting a manual-transmission vehicle, set the gearshift to neutral. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A30
In the handbook's keyed starting procedure, turn the ignition to on before checking the indicators and gauges. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A30
Check the indicator lights and gauges before turning the ignition from on to start. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A30
After starting in the described procedure, switch on the low-beam headlights. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A30
After starting in the described procedure, lock the doors. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A30
To prepare an automatic-transmission vehicle to move, release the parking brake and hold the brake pedal before selecting drive. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F12 | anchor: A30
To prepare a manual-transmission vehicle to move, hold the clutch fully down and shift from neutral to first. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F13 | anchor: A30
For the described manual-transmission departure, press the brake pedal before releasing the parking brake. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F14 | anchor: A30
Before moving off, check that the path ahead is safe. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F15 | anchor: A30
Before moving off, check for traffic beside and behind the vehicle. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F16 | anchor: A30
Signal before moving off, and move only when it is safe. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F17 | anchor: A30
When moving off safely, press the accelerator gently. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F18 | anchor: A30
In a clutch-equipped vehicle, release the clutch slowly when moving off. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F19 | anchor: A30
Abrupt clutch release can make the vehicle jerk forward. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F20 | anchor: A30
Abrupt clutch release can stall the engine. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F21 | anchor: A30
Accelerate smoothly with the top of the foot on the pedal and the heel on the floor. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F22 | anchor: A30
Excessively fast acceleration can spin the drive wheels, particularly on a slippery surface. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F23 | anchor: A30
Wheelspin during excessively fast acceleration can make the vehicle slide. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F24 | anchor: A30
Increase speed gradually when rain, snow, sand or gravel reduces traction. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F25 | anchor: A30
Too much power when traction is poor can spin the drive wheels and lead to loss of control. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F26 | anchor: A30
If the drive wheels begin spinning, lift the foot from the accelerator. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F27 | anchor: A30
When stopping an automatic-transmission vehicle, check the mirrors for traffic. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F28 | anchor: A30
When moving an automatic-transmission vehicle toward the curb to stop, check over the shoulder and signal. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F29 | anchor: A30
At a stop sign or traffic signal, use the appropriate stopping position behind the sign, stop line or crosswalk. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F30 | anchor: A30
Begin the described stopping procedure by releasing the accelerator so the vehicle slows. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F31 | anchor: A30
Apply steady brake-pedal pressure for a smooth stop. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F32 | anchor: A30
Where applicable, press the clutch and select first gear when the vehicle has stopped. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F33 | anchor: A30
Turn the steering wheel toward the direction the vehicle should move, whether traveling forward or reversing. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F34 | anchor: A30
Place both hands on opposite outside sides of the steering wheel. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F35 | anchor: A30
Use a firm but gentle grip on the steering wheel. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F36 | anchor: A30
Grip the wheel with the fingers rather than the palms. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F37 | anchor: A30
Keep the thumbs up along the face of the steering wheel. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec05-F38 | anchor: A30
Never steer while gripping the inside of the wheel's rim. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0030]

Misconceptions: Compare transmission and steering-method conditions in the fact blocks; do not transfer a condition to a different procedure.
Mnemonics: Editorial retrieval cue: prepare, observe, move, stop; the cue adds no driving rule.
Glossary: Use the sourced blocks to distinguish hand-to-hand, hand-over-hand, evasive and one-hand steering.
Dynamic facts: Vehicle-specific controls depend on the owner's manual; ambiguous instructions remain typed source debt rather than guessed equipment behavior.
